name: Sommer-Funpark Fiss
kurzbeschreibung: Sommer-Funpark Fiss at 1,812 m Möseralm: alpine action adventure world featuring Fisser Flitzer, Fisser Flieger, Skyswing, and giant slides.
beschreibung:
Overview

The action-packed Sommer-Funpark Fiss is situated on a sun-drenched plateau at an elevation of 1,812 meters at the mid-station of the Möseralmbahn in the Tyrolean municipality of Fiss (Landeck district). As the vibrant heart of the summer offering in the holiday region Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis, this destination ranks among the most spectacular alpine leisure and adventure parks in all of Austria. Framed by the majestic backdrop of the Ötztaler Alpen and the Oberinntal valley, the park pairs globally unique flight and ride attractions with family-friendly playgrounds, a petting zoo, and cozy alpine mountain lodges.

Route & Requirements

The park's signature attractions deliver unforgettable adrenaline rushes for guests of all ages. The undisputed star is the Fisser Flitzer: on a 2.2-kilometer alpine coaster track, riders descend nearly 370 vertical meters down to Fiss; speeding at up to 45 km/h through sharp banked curves, bridges, tunnels, and surprise elements such as the pirate ship bend and ice cave tunnel. Truly unique in the Alps is the Fisser Flieger: four passengers are secured face-down inside a glider-like flight apparatus and soar suspended from a cable pulley system up to 47 meters above the ground, reaching speeds of up to 80 km/h over the alpine pastures of the Möseralm. For those with a head for heights, the colossal giant swing Skyswing offers pure thrill: the pendulum catapults daring riders into weightlessness across three distinct intensity levels (ranging from gentle swinging to full 360-degree inversions pulling 4G forces). For younger visitors, the park also boasts a giant tubing run, climbing towers, the Fiss air cushion for leaps from heights of three meters, Kneipp pools, and a spacious animal enclosure.

Visit & Arrival

Sommer-Funpark Fiss is open throughout the summer season from mid-June to mid-October daily from 08:30 to 17:00. Access to the fun park area and playgrounds at the Möseralm is free of charge. Riding the main attractions (Fisser Flitzer, Fisser Flieger, Skyswing) requires individual tickets or value cards. Ride prices (2025/2026 season): single ride Fisser Flitzer adults approx. €9.50, children (born 2011–2018) approx. €6.50; Fisser Flieger adults approx. €10.50, children approx. €7.50; Skyswing adults approx. €9.00, children approx. €6.50. Holders of the Super. Sommer. Card. ride the mountain cable cars for free. Getting there by gondola: the Möseralmbahn departs directly from the valley station in Fiss and brings visitors directly to the fun park in about eight minutes. By car: via the B180 (Reschenstraße) to Ried im Oberinntal, continuing along the L19 up to Fiss to the large cable car parking facilities. By public transport: take the ÖBB train to Landeck-Zams station, connecting to bus line 220 directly into Fiss.

Tips

The Möseralmbahn gondola, the paved paths across the fun park, and the panoramic restaurant Möseralm feature exemplary barrier-free access for wheelchair users and baby strollers. Every Tuesday during the summer, the popular Lange Nacht von Fiss takes place, during which the park and its attractions remain illuminated and open until 22:00. Be sure to stop at the mountain restaurant Möseralm to enjoy authentic Tyrolean Gröstl on the panoramic sun terrace.
oeffnungszeiten: Mitte Juni bis Mitte Okt täglich 08:30–17:00 Uhr (Bergbahnbetrieb)
